question: Does Qwen3-30B-A3B serve >= 16K KV tokens on a 16 GB RTX 5080 (UD-IQ3_XXS), and what fits on a 24 GB RTX 4090 (Q4_K_M)? (M0.2 acceptance 5, design §4.7)
command: fit: an engine at memory_fraction 0.98, max_model_len 16384, then one 16128-token prompt generating 64 tokens
settings: memory_fraction 0.98, max_step_tokens 2048, page_size 16, bf16 KV (96 KiB/token)
note: free_memory: GiB free after weights; the KV is 0.98 x that - the worst step's peak - the graph pool. Prompt-logprob scoring (L2) at 0.98 on the 5080 ran out of memory (~50 MB of margin is below allocator slack); the lock was tuned at the default 0.9, which plans the same kernels.
